notes: First CMA-ES search space for policies.ctrl_v1:CtrlV1 -- 15 knobs, chosen
for the mechanisms the module docstring calls decisive: the per-zone PI
gains, the comfort margin / economic shift, the demand -> supply-air
temperature pair, the economizer threshold, the hot-water reset, the
_floor_guard and the unoccupied-window start/stop. 'init' is deliberately
omitted everywhere: sbx.tune reads the live PARAMS of the policy class, so
a change to a default propagates without touching this file.
Ranges are the plausible operating envelope, not the default +-50%: a
linear scale maps [lo, hi] to [0, 1], log uses a geometric interpolation
(lo > 0), int rounds after the linear map, bool thresholds at x >= 0.5.
